# The live checkout on the server (~/public_html, a git checkout of origin/main)
# and the live site at https://usydastro.org/ both stand at:
LIVE_SERVER_GIT_REV=d08c8f8
#
# This file's own commit is bookkeeping on top of that rev, so it is one commit
# ahead of what it records; the authoritative marker is the server's
# ~/suas-data/.deploy-commit.
#
# How this deploy ran: git push origin HEAD:main, then git pull --ff-only in
# ~/public_html (the flow in README.md, Deploying). Before the pull the server's
# working tree carried hand-rsynced copies of the four asset files from the
# previous deploy; their md5s were checked byte-identical to the commit, then
# discarded so the pull restored identical committed content.
#
# Verified on d08c8f8:
#  - no hybrid: local, origin/main and the server all resolve to d08c8f8, and
#    every tracked code file now matches the repo (the four asset files are
#    committed, so the live site no longer runs anything uncommitted)
#  - the competition title sits a normal distance above the photos sent in: /
#    serves section--half-bottom and section--half-top, the served
#    assets/css/style.css?v=... carries all four half-padding rules including
#    the narrow-window overrides, and the browser measures 18.2px + 18.2px
#    (36px gap) at 1280px and 13px + 13px (26px gap) on a narrow window, which
#    is what the doubled-class modifiers are there to survive
#  - the mtime stamp on the stylesheet URL changed with the file, so browsers
#    that cached the old sheet for a week now fetch the new one
#  - photos untouched by the pull: photos/submissions/30.jpg and its thumbnail
#    answer 200, photos/01.jpg and its thumbnail answer 200, the removed
#    photos/20.jpg still answers 404, and the strip renders its three tiles
#    with 19 gallery tiles behind it
#  - /, /about.php and /admin.php answer 200 (upload.php answers 405 to a GET:
#    it is POST-only), and the page console is clean
#
# State, not a fault of the deploy:
#  - the server's working tree holds intentional deletions: photos/20.jpg,
#    photos/queue/22.jpg and 23.jpg and their thumbnails (taken down or
#    rejected earlier). git pull leaves them alone while no commit touches
#    photos/, but deploy.sh's rsync steps would restore them, so deploy.sh
#    remains unusable until its photos step is fixed
#  - mail.log records the earlier notification as "sent", which means the host's
#    MTA took it. Whether it reaches an inbox rather than a spam folder is not
#    something this file can attest to; SPF and DMARC exist for usydastro.org
#  - the From address is photos@usydastro.org, which is not a mailbox or a
#    forwarder on this account. It is on the sending domain, which is what SPF
#    needs, and replies go to the submitter via Reply-To. Set notify_from in
#    ~/suas-config.php if that should change
